Maya (Marketing): quick heads-up — yesterday ~27 leads sat unassigned >3m. root cause looks like enrichment timeout + a round-robin assignment edge. can we do a short workshop to lock SLAs and routing heuristics? propose Wed 30m.
John (Sales Ops): ugh, saw that spike too. can you drop the sample metric windows? iirc spike started ~18:12 UTC.
Maya (Marketing): yup — attaching the summary from alerts: 18:12–18:25 UTC, inbound rate normal, enrichment latency P95 jumped to 14s, rr assign failures 1.8% in that window.
Priya (Growth): target suggestion: median assign <30s for MQLs, fallback to overflow after 60s, enrichment timeout 10s. that should keep reps from missing hot leads. :thumbsup:
Erik (Eng): note: continuous batching on the enrichment worker increased tail a bit during that window. quick wins: reduce batch max wait from 200ms -> 50ms for HS webhook path, and short-circuit routing if enrichment not required for claim.
Sam (Ops): can you paste the HS workflow snippet we currently use? i need to confirm webhook retry/backoff settings.
Maya (Marketing): here you go — this is the inbound plumbing that triggers our route lambda:

```
Workflow: "Inbound -> Enrich -> Route -> Claim"
Steps:
  - webhook: POST /api/inbound (HS connector)
  - enrich: call /enrich (third-party + internal cache)
  - route: route-service (round-robin / overflow)
  - claim: assign to rep via SF/HS owner mapping
```

curl example we use from HS webhook: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/leadroute \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'X-HubSpot-Signature: {{sig}}' \
  -d '{"lead_id":"{{id}}","payload":{{all_fields}}}'
```
Erik (Eng): proposed routing config (simple heuristic) — please review:
```
routing:
  claim_window_sec: 45
  overflow_after_sec: 75
  enrichment_timeout_sec: 10
  owner_refresh: true
```
Erik (Eng): explanation: claim_window_sec = how long RR waits for a rep to ack before next rotation; overflow_after_sec = when to send to overflow SDR pool; enrichment_timeout_sec = how long we wait for enrichment before routing a partial lead. owner_refresh toggles a quick owner-id lookup refresh to avoid stale mappings.
Jesse (CS): +1 on owner_refresh. saw multiple cases where stale owner mapping returned null and claim syscall failed. that caused manual follow-up. we need telemetry to capture owner-mismatch counts.
Priya (Growth): can we add a fallback that routes with whatever enrichment we have (partial) + flags 'missing_enrich=true' so SDRs know to follow up? better than losing the lead.
Erik (Eng): yep — route-partial flag is easy. default behavior: if enrichment didn't finish by enrichment_timeout_sec, attach partial payload and add meta.missing_enrich = true.
Sam (Ops): for HubSpot webhook settings: reduce retry attempts to 3 and set webhook TTL to 10s at HS side so we don't pile up long-lived connections. i'll check if marketplace connector has limits.
John (Sales Ops): action items then:
  - John: update HS webhook TTL and retry config (owner: John)
  - Erik: PR for routing config + partial-route flag + reduce batch wait (owner: Erik)
  - Priya: run 24h smoke test on canary traffic and report assign latency (owner: Priya)
  - Jesse: add owner-mismatch metric and dashboards (owner: Jesse)
  - Maya: create job spec for the Wed 30m workshop and invite reps + eng + ops (owner: Maya)

Maya (Marketing): proposed timeline: config PR by Fri, canary test Mon, full roll early next week if green.
Erik (Eng): i can get a draft PR by EOD Thu. quick question — do we want overflow_after_sec 75 or 60? 75 gives reps extra time but increases lead wait.
Priya (Growth): i vote 60 for initial rollout. shorter waits for high-intent leads. we can tweak with percentiles after we have telemetry.
John (Sales Ops): 60s works. reps would prefer quicker overflow to SDRs rather than waiting.
leads-bot: alert summary: 2026-03-20 18:12 UTC — 27 unassigned leads >180s; enrichment latency P95=14s; rr fail rate spike 1.8% — ticket #INC-2026-119 created.
Maya (Marketing): perfect — i'll book the slot Wed 10:00 PT and add the agenda: 1) metric review 2) routing config proposal 3) rollout plan + rollback 4) ownership edge-cases.
Erik (Eng): :eyes: i'll drop the PR draft link in the thread when ready.
Jesse (CS): will add owner-mismatch panel to the support dashboard and a query for recent manual claims so we can triage.
Sam (Ops): i'll audit connector retry rules and confirm HS limits before Friday.
Priya (Growth): thanks all — excited to close this gap. :slightly_smiling_face:
John (Sales Ops): thanks — :thumbsup: will prep any sales-side notes for the workshop.
